description: Make a link to one of the workspace's recipes. Whoever opens it can copy the recipe with recipe_import, as it is now; later changes do not reach their copy. The recipe holds no media of yours (fonts are named, not sent). The link works for 30 days.

id.description: The recipe's id or name (see recipe_list with mine=true)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_share
title: Share a recipe
